name: goalscout-agent
description: Live football goal alerts, match memory, legal where-to-watch guidance, and channel delivery for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, and agent platforms.

interface.shortDescription: Live football goals, match alerts, and watch guides
interface.longDescription: Track favorite teams, players, competitions, and legal watching platforms with SportScore-powered live football checks, persistent memory, optional BYOK broadcast lookup, npm-style CLI installation, and delivery to Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, webhooks, custom commands, or the console.
defaultPrompt: Use $goalscout-agent to set up my live goal alerts.
Use $goalscout-agent to check today's football updates.
Use $goalscout-agent to connect alerts to Hermes.
Use $goalscout-agent from Claude Code or OpenCode to run football checks.
Use $goalscout-agent to find where I can legally watch a football match.
